messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-2026-4829 fired: redis-acceptqueue high on shard eu-west-1 (severity: P1). Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-2026-4829 :rotating_light:
pagerbot: auto-escalation scheduled in 2m if no ack.
maya: acked. I'm looking. seeing lots of CLIENTS and slow responses on redis-01/eu-west-1. Kernel sockets ~ CLOSE_WAIT.
sam: Maya - can you paste `INFO clients`? I can start draining a few worker nodes if needed.
maya: paste below:
```
# output of redis-cli -h redis-01 info clients
connected_clients:8996
blocked_clients:124
maxclients:10000
```
jordan: pg appears to be impacted too, pgbouncer queue_length jump at the same time. `pg_stat_activity` shows a ton of idle-in-transaction from background jobs.
lee: Confirming, apigw v2 is returning 502s for some write paths. Error rate up ~7% last 3min. Top customer clusters: corp-analytics and realtime-streaming.
oncall-sre: Noted customer impact — high-rate write paths degraded, read paths mostly ok but some timeouts.
maya: Hypothesis: a traffic surge + slow background job causing connection pool bleed -> redis accept queue fills -> clients backpressure -> pgbouncer backlog.
sam: Mitigation plan: 1) drain two worker ASGs (lowest traffic) 2) increase redis `maxclients` not ideal, prefer throttle at app 3) restart one sentinel on replica to rotate accept queue.
jordan: I'm happy to restart the sentinel leader if you want. Which host?
maya: Restart sentinel on redis-02 (replica), rolling. I'll coordinate.
pagerbot: pagerduty: PD-2026-4829 was acknowledged by maya at 1719876551. Auto-escalation canceled.
sam: Draining workers now: `kubectl scale deployment app-workers --replicas=4 --namespace=prod` -> previously 8.
lee: I'm toggling feature-flag for realtime ingestion to reduce write fanout: `ffctl set realtime_ingest disable --env prod`
maya: Restarting sentinel on redis-02: `sudo systemctl restart redis-sentinel` -> waiting for cluster re-election.
jordan: While that happens, I'm patching pgbouncer config to reduce `max_client_conn` to force backlog shedding: editing `pgbouncer.ini` on pool nodes and reloading.
oncall-sre: Quick check: K8s pod evictions spiked? any noisy cron jobs?
maya: There's a nightly aggregate that started early thanks to a timezone bug. It kicked off at 03:00 UTC and overlaps with a marketing campaign spike. Confirmed heavy DB writes at 03:02.
sam: Good catch — throttling that cron will help. I'm pausing the job: `kubectl delete job nightly-agg-2026-03 --namespace=prod` temporarily.
pagerbot: pagerduty: escalation to oncall-sre in 1 minute if no update.
lee: Error rate down to 3% after drains + FF. Redis connected_clients dipped to 6.2k.
maya: Sentinel re-election complete, replicas reattached. redis acceptqueue length decreasing.
jordan: pgbouncer queue_length falling from 120 -> 12. PG latency tail down to normal.
oncall-sre: Customer impact: now limited, but corp-analytics still showing some failed batches. Ops to follow up with CS.
sam: Rolling back the scale change in 10m once stable. Also adding a short-term HA rule to infra to prevent >75% connection saturation alerts ramping PD loops.
maya: Next steps for post-incident: 1) postmortem (owner: maya) 2) add autoscaling policy for worker ASG on queue length 3) add circuit-breaker in app for write fanout 4) fix cron timezone bug (owner: jordan).
lee: Thanks team. I'll draft a customer impact note and ping CS.
oncall-sre: Incident marked 'mitigated' at 1719877012. Please file follow-ups in #incidents and link this thread.
maya: handing off to sam for watch period (30m). sam - take it, I'll be offline for 20m.
sam: taking watch. will monitor dashboards and react if anything recurs.
pagerbot: PD-2026-4829 status: resolved by maya at 1719877020.
maya: closing — tl;dr: write-heavy job + marketing spike => connection pool bleed -> redis acceptqueue surge -> APIGW 502s. Mitigated via worker drain + feature-flag + stopping cron + sentinel restart. Postmortem to follow. :white_check_mark:
